name: Avatar
summary: Honey DS avatar: photo, initials or icon; 9 sizes, circle or rounded, solid or subtle; colour derived from the name.
useWhen: Representing a person (customer, agent) or an inbox next to their name or in a list row.
avoidWhen: Brand or app logos (use the image directly) or status indicators (use Badge).

props.name: name
props.description: Person or inbox name: the accessible name, the initials and the default colour.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL (Figma Type=Picture). Initials show until it loads, or if it fails.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon instead of initials (Figma Type=Icon). Pass an @honey-ds/icons element.

props.name: background
props.description: Figma `Background`.

props.name: color
props.description: Figma `Color`. Defaults to a stable colour derived from `name`.

name: EmptyState
summary: Honey DS empty state: circular icon, title, optional description and one optional primary action; sm, md and lg.
useWhen: A list, search or panel has nothing to show (empty inbox, no search results, no notes yet).
avoidWhen: Errors (use a Banner or Toast) or loading (use Skeleton); never as a placeholder for content that is still arriving.

props.name: title
props.description: The main line, e.g. "No conversations".

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting line (Figma `subheading`).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon inside the circle. Defaults to the search glyph Figma uses; pass an @honey-ds/icons element.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the single primary action (Figma `action`). Rendered only with `onAction`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Render the title as a heading (h2–h4) when the empty state is the main content of a region.
